methodology.timing: Binding, cached SQL parsing, candidate planning, filtering, exact scoring and result construction; excludes fixture loading, reference queries, HTTP, providers and persistence.
methodology.percentiles: Median of three process medians and three process p95 values; each process uses nearest-rank p95.
methodology.correctness: Every timed result matches full-scan/full-sort reference, including exact vector scores and source-order ties; canonical output digests match between all variants at each scale.
methodology.build_isolation: Separate source and target directories, identical harness source, distinct binary SHA-256 digests. No concurrent builds/tests during timing.

validation.release_smoke: PASS vectors-server 0.11.0: embedded PDF/chat UI, capacity and chat APIs, authenticated SQL/vector/GraphRAG APIs, seed document caps, typed filters, relationships, join chains, restart, local provider key files and environment precedence

limitations: Synthetic vectors do not measure semantic recall, provider latency, production concurrency or end-to-end indexing throughput.
Tested at 100000 SQL units, not ten million documents. GraphRAG capacity remains unchanged.
Two-chat vector median at 20000 rows regressed about 2.9%; improvements depend on filter shape and selectivity.
Large key-lookup ratios compare maintained unique-index access with previous full-table scans.
Catalog remains memory-resident and exact vector scoring still scales with the eligible set.
